title: Automation for Dental Clinics & Med Spas

blocks.heading: Fill Empty Chairs *on Autopilot*
blocks.lead: Automated reminders, AI booking, and smart recall campaigns cut no-shows and rebook dormant patients — while your team focuses on the patients in front of them.

items.title: A no-show costs me the slot and the staff time.
items.body: That chair sat empty all afternoon. You never get that revenue back.

items.title: My front desk can't call 400 overdue patients.
items.body: Recall lists sit in the software, untouched. Nobody calls, nobody rebooks.

items.title: Booking is a game of phone tag.
items.body: New patients call during business hours only. The practice that answered first got them.

items.title: Happy patients never leave reviews.
items.body: The quiet, satisfied ones say nothing. The unhappy ones write essays.

header.title: Your front desk, *automated 24/7*
header.subtitle: Runs alongside your practice management software. No new systems for your staff to learn.

items.title: Smart Reminders
items.body: SMS and email confirmations go out automatically, with easy reschedule links. Fewer no-shows, fewer gaps in the day.

items.title: AI Booking, Day or Night
items.body: New and existing patients book online or by phone around the clock. Open slots fill themselves while you're closed.

items.title: Recall + Review Engine
items.body: Overdue patients get friendly automated recall sequences. Happy patients are asked for a review at just the right moment.

blocks.math: 8 fewer no-shows/month × $200 avg visit value = *~$1,600/month recovered*
blocks.assumptions: Assumptions: automated reminders cut your no-shows by 8 appointments per month; average visit value $200. Recall campaigns and new review-driven bookings are extra on top. Your numbers will differ — the free audit maps your actual schedule.
blocks.disclaimer: Illustrative estimate for example purposes only. Actual results vary by specialty, schedule, and patient base.

items.title: HIPAA-Aware Workflows
items.body: Patient data handled with healthcare-grade care.

items.title: USA-Based Support
items.body: Real humans, your timezone, fast answers.

items.title: SMB-Friendly Pricing
items.body: Built for single and multi-location practices.

items.title: Live in 1–2 Weeks
items.body: Connected to your existing scheduling software.

items.title: No Long-Term Contracts
items.body: Month-to-month. If chairs stay empty, walk away.

header.title: See exactly where *patients are leaking*
header.subtitle: A 30-minute working session — not a sales pitch. You leave with a fixed-quote plan whether or not you hire us.

items.title: Schedule Leak Map
items.body: We trace your no-shows, unfilled slots, and dormant recall list — and put a dollar figure on what they're costing you.

items.title: Fixed-Quote Plan
items.body: You get an exact scope, timeline, and price for the reminder, booking, and recall system that fills your chairs. No hourly billing.

items.title: Zero Commitment
items.body: Keep the plan and implement it yourself, or hand it to us. The audit is free either way.

items.a: It depends on scope — reminders only versus full booking, recall, and review automation. The free audit gives you a fixed quote before you spend anything.
No. We connect to your existing practice management and scheduling software. Your staff keeps the tools they know.

items.q: How fast can this be live?
items.a: Most systems are up and running in 1–2 weeks, including testing against your actual appointment flow.
You never touch code. Once it's live, reminders, booking, and recalls run themselves — your team just sees fuller schedules.

blocks.heading: Empty chairs are *expensive.*
blocks.body: Your front desk can't call everyone — automation can. Get your free audit and see what a fuller schedule looks like.

seo.metaDescription: Automated reminders, AI booking, and smart recall campaigns fill chairs while your team treats patients. Free automation audit for dental clinics and med spas.
